clue.text: Try anything, having cooked tarts after batch of eggs was cracked

indicators.note: the tarts come after the batch of eggs, so these pieces follow it

parts.note: a clutch is a set of eggs laid and hatched together

indicators.note: food that is cooked is worked over, so the word tarts is rearranged
something cracked is broken apart, so the word was is rearranged

explanation.surface: A desperate baker improvises with tarts once the eggs have broken.
explanation.walkthrough: Two separate anagram signals work here: 'cooked' on tarts and 'cracked' on was, with 'having' only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom: when desperate a person will grasp at any slight chance, trying anything at all.

clue.text: Summer hyacinths I extracted — in replacement, these?

definitions.text: Summer hyacinths I extracted — in replacement, these?

indicators.note: the remaining letters are put in a new order, replaced in fresh positions
the letter I is pulled out of the two words before it

explanation.surface: A gardener wonders which flowers might replace summer hyacinths once those are dug up.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove I from SUMMER HYACINTHS and 'in replacement' rearranges the remaining fourteen letters. The whole clue also hints at autumn blooms replacing the summer ones.
explanation.definitionFit: These autumn-flowering plants are a natural replacement in borders once summer bulbs such as hyacinths are over.

clue.text: Ancient character raised rural storage on end of plantation

parts.note: something raised is up

indicators.note: only the final letter of the word plantation is taken

explanation.surface: A historical figure lifts a farm's grain store at the edge of an estate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' just places the pieces one after another in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A letter of the Greek alphabet, so a character from an ancient script.

clue.text: Radio component ideal in quantity?

the plural phrase 'the ...' means the very best, so one of them is the ideal taken in a smaller quantity

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a radio part is the perfect amount of something.
explanation.definitionFit: A wire in early crystal radio sets, and singular of the phrase for the absolute best thing.

clue.text: Prominent people picked up about heading off bogus dodgy medicine

clue.text: Nothing removed from cross bar

clue.text: Award for nothing kind of dog with tail put up, coming first
